value.title: Rate limiter lets bursts through after a restart
value.taskBrief: After a deploy, the token bucket starts full for every client, so the first minute lets 10x the allowed traffic through. Make the bucket state survive a restart. The hidden tests exercise limiter.py directly.

testFiles.content:
from limiter import Limiter

def test_state_survives_restart(tmp_path):
    a = Limiter(rate=1, burst=1, state_dir=tmp_path)
    assert a.allow('c')
    b = Limiter(rate=1, burst=1, state_dir=tmp_path)
    assert not b.allow('c')

ticket.title: Refund webhooks are processed twice
ticket.body: Stripe retries refund webhooks when we answer slowly, and each retry issues another refund. Make refund handling safe to receive more than once.
acceptance: A refund webhook delivered twice refunds the customer once

personas.name: Dana Ortiz
personas.owns: Refund policy and the Stripe integration
personas.brief: Direct and busy. Answers precisely when asked a precise question.

requirements.text: Deduplicate on the webhook event id
Remember processed event ids for 30 days, matching Stripe's retry window

orgApiKey.description: Organization API key from Settings → API. Send Authorization: Bearer psk_live_… .

testCommand.description: Runs from the repository root after setup. Hidden files overwrite destination paths after setup. Preparation requires tests to run and be counted, not to pass.

setupCommand.description: Install dependencies only. Must exit zero; commands that run test suites are rejected.

brief.description: Tone and habits only. Repeating hidden requirements returns 422 brief_restates_requirement.

anyOf.description: Persona ID, or null when held by nobody. No teammate can reveal an unowned row; it is still evaluated and an absent required row is missed, with no teammate-message evidence.

ticketImplied.description: Whether the ticket implies this requirement. Independent of owner and not an evaluation exemption.

tests.description: Links to node:test TAP names before the colon, e.g. dedupe: handles retry. pytest/vitest/jest links are untested; suite pass/fail still applies.

TicketFlow.description: Persona and requirement IDs must each be unique. Owners and unavailability personaId must refer to a persona. fromSec must precede toSec. With ticketFlow, the ticket replaces title and taskBrief.

commitSha.description: Omit to pin the current default-branch head.

isPrivate.description: Uses the organization GitHub token from Settings → GitHub access. Candidates receive a snapshot without credentials or history.

CustomProblemInput.description: POST creates; PUT fully replaces. language is trimmed and lowercased before validation. A successful save starts preparation; inspect issue.prepStatus, including on the initial response.

allowedTools.description: Requires usable organization provider keys. Omit to derive tools from available keys. Cursor and candidate-paid subscriptions are retired.
